instruction: Songs of which genre have I liked the most in my Spotify song library?
notes: Read-only question task: no database changes are allowed, so the model only contains lookup actions and the final answer. The plan is: get passwords, log into Spotify, list the song library (gives song ids + genres), list liked songs, intersect them and count genres; the genre with the maximum count is the answer passed to supervisor.complete_task. The genre object is a runtime value (most-liked-genre), asserted by the knowledge predicate found-most-liked-genre once both listings are known (library listing is required before the liked-songs listing to give the planner a fixed order). Pagination of show_song_library/show_liked_songs is left to the executing agent and not modeled as separate steps.
